bullets: Nutriva Masala Blend in a 250 ml carton, sourced from a single origin for consistent character

Rich amber-toned blend, ready to use in curries, gravies, marinades and rice dishes
Net quantity 250 ml; MRP Rs. 299 (inclusive of all taxes)
Imported by Nutriva Pvt Ltd, Spain; country of origin: Spain
listing.description: Bring a single-origin masala blend to your everyday Indian kitchen with Nutriva Masala Blend. Packed in a 250 ml carton, this amber-toned blend is crafted with no added preservatives, so you get a clean-label pantry staple for your daily cooking. Stir it into curries, dals, gravies, marinades and rice preparations to add a balanced, aromatic base without extra additives. Sourced from a single origin, the blend offers a consistent character from pack to pack. Net quantity: 250 ml. MRP: Rs. 299 (inclusive of all taxes). Country of origin: Spain. Manufacturer / Importer: Nutriva Pvt Ltd, Spain. For product queries or feedback, reach consumer care at care@example-brand.test. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight; keep the carton closed after use to retain freshness. SKU: SKU-1003.
